title: STATE OF THE TECH JOB MARKET IN 2026
summary_en:
Lenny Rachitsky (@lennysan) posts the fifth of his twice-yearly checks on tech hiring and job openings, and calls this late-2026 edition the most surprising yet. The public X post is a seven-point index plus a link to the longer report. Worth archiving because those headline shifts are the citable record, and they are easy to lose once the feed moves on.

- Product-management openings are at a four-year high, which is why he says PMs are winning in the AI era.
- Engineering openings have stalled for the first time in this series.
- Product design sits at a low the post calls a record low, and remote roles are at a record low too.
- AI skills now appear in core-role job descriptions; the post says every role requires them.
- Jobs are concentrating in the Bay Area, while the market is still growing, mostly outside software.
summary_zh:
Lenny Rachitsky（@lennysan）一年两次梳理科技招聘与岗位空缺。这是第五份，他称 2026 年末这一期最出乎意料。公开的 X 帖只是七点索引，并链向更长的报告。值得存档，因为这些方向才是日后可引用的记录，时间线一过就容易被冲掉。

- 产品经理空缺处在近四年高点，因此他说产品经理正在 AI 时代取胜。
- 工程岗位空缺出现停滞，而且是这个系列里的第一次。
- 产品设计处于低位，帖中称为纪录低点；远程岗位同样是纪录低点。
- AI 技能已普遍写进核心角色的职位描述，帖中说每个角色都要求具备。
- 岗位向湾区集中；市场仍在增长，增长主要发生在软件之外。
full_text:
STATE OF THE TECH JOB MARKET IN 2026

Twice a year, I dig into trends in hiring and job openings. This is the fifth report I've done, and the most surprising yet:

1. PMs are winning in the AI era
2. Engineering demand has stalled
3. Design openings are at a record low
4. Every role now requires AI skills
5. Tech jobs are concentrating in the Bay Area
6. Remote roles are at a record low
7. The tech job market is growing fast, but mostly outside of software (gasp!)

Full report here: https://t.co/Gly6uqwKxe
